title: VerificationObservationRecord
description: Standard schema for independent external availability checks and re-upload observations performed by the verifier (Half 2).

request_id.description: Target request identifier matching the police takedown request log.

observation_status.description: Independently observed state of the targeted content at last_checked_at.

last_checked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the verifier polled or analyzed the target.

verifier_agent_id.description: Identifier of the verifier module, simulator, or auditor agent.

verified_removed_at.description: Empirically verified ISO 8601 timestamp when content was confirmed inaccessible.

reupload_detected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when an identical or perceptual match was detected re-uploaded.

notes.description: Sanitized technical observation remarks (HTTP status, error codes, etc.).
